name: quetrex-base
description: Quetrex — the Claude Code plugin engine (agents, skills, commands, hooks). Distributed as a plugin, not an npm package; this package.json exists only to run the repo's dev/verify scripts.

scripts.check:sh: for f in .claude/hooks/*.sh .claude/lib/*.sh .claude/*.sh .claude/skills/*/*.sh .claude/skills/*/scripts/*.sh bin/* test/*.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['package.json','.claude/settings.json','.claude/templates/verify.json','.quetrex/verify.json','.claude-plugin/plugin.json','hooks/hooks.json'];for(const f of files){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}console.log('ok - '+files.length+' JSON files parse')"
scripts.test: node test/plugin.test.js && for f in test/*.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "--- $f ---"; bash "$f" || exit 1; done
